1. **Conditions Satisfaction**: Work toward satisfying all SPA Conditions

3. **Ancillary Documents**: Execute Employment Agreement and other ancillary documents

| Closing (29 Jun 2026) | Medium | Coordination of multiple pre-closing actions required | Project management of all pre-closing steps |

| Escrow Claim Notification (45 days) | High | Consent requirement adds complexity | Clear internal procedures for claim management |
| Escrow Deposit (18 May 2026) | Medium | Seller obligation; failure breaches Escrow Agreement | Monitor Seller compliance |
| Business Day Definition Gap | Medium | SPA lacks Business Day definition creating uncertainty for Saturday deadlines | Add Business Day definition to SPA |

7. **Clarify SPA Conditions**: Request specification of all Conditions referenced in Clause 4 to enable proper timeline planning.

2. **Regulatory Clearance Process**: Assumes clearance will be obtained by 12 September 2026 as advised by regulatory counsel. Actual timing may vary.
